features.note: Faithful single-page migration. WinUI renders a full non-blank frame; all source controls present in the UIA tree with correct AutomationIds (PreviewControl, CycleModeButton+ModeTextBlock 'Standard', PhotoButton, HdrImpactBar, SceneTypeTextBlock, HDR Analyzer label) and correct layout (buttons right, HDR bar bottom). Both buttons are correctly disabled because no camera is present (IsEnabled=False until camera init) — this matches the UWP intent, not a dead-control regression; the UWP golden itself was camera-gated (stuck on splash) so no control 'responded in UWP but dead in WinUI'. WinUI additionally shows a graceful no-camera FallbackPanel. Visual fidelity verified against source XAML + live UIA; full running-UWP pixel comparison limited only by the absent camera hardware.
